title: The Secret in the Night
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who goes looking, and tonight Daniel goes looking for an answer no wise man in Babylon could find. Stopping to ask Heavenly Father first, then finding the blue sock in the laundry basket, is Scout’s kind of discovery.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Daniel went looking for an answer only Heavenly Father could give. In Scout’s world today: Scout cannot find his blue sock anywhere. He stops hunting, sits on the rug, and asks Heavenly Father to help him remember. Then he thinks of the laundry basket, and there it is! Just like Daniel praying with his friends before the answer came, Scout learned that asking Heavenly Father first is the best kind of looking.
